data.rationale: The proposal follows the true path (Menu > Agencies > Bridges & Tunnels > Tolls by vehicle > select vehicle type > read rate) in the right order, but it omits the facility parameter, hedges with "or" alternatives, and lists the vehicle options loosely, so an automation would need some guesswork.
